title: The Obedience of the Rechabites and Jeremiah's Warning
description: God uses the unwavering obedience of the Rechabites to their ancestor Jonadab as a mirror to condemn the people of Judah for their disobedience to the Lord's commands. While the Rechabites hold fast to their traditions even during Nebuchadnezzar's invasion, Jeremiah is told that the people of Judah will be punished for ignoring the prophets' warnings, whereas Jonadab's descendants shall stand before the Lord.
